_instructions: Offer landing pages, generated at /offers/<slug>. Content taken verbatim where possible from the live standalone offer sites: consumerchoice.epaypos.net, epaybonussignup.epaypos.net and freestatementreview.netlify.app. Terms and eligibility are commercial claims — do not edit them without checking with whoever owns the offer.
_note_on_conflicts: Those three sites all quote LEASE AT $49.99/mo for Table and Retail, as does the Wix products page. pricing.json currently uses $59.99 because that is what Matt said. Four sources against one — worth confirming. The bonus site also quotes 2.6% Interchange Plus for accounts under $50K/mo, which is a rate that does not exist anywhere in pricing.json.

offers.badge: $3,000 Switch Bonus · Restaurants, Bars & Retail Only
offers.heading: Switch Your POS. Earn $3,000.
offers.lede: Restaurants, bars and retail stores that switch an existing POS to EPAY get a $3,000 bonus — plus $0 Consumer Choice processing going forward.
checks: Must be switching an existing POS

snapshot.title: Switch bonus snapshot
snapshot.footnote: Paid to qualifying merchants switching from an existing POS system. See eligibility below.

steps.title: Tell Us What You're Switching From
steps.body: Share your current POS system and a recent statement — takes about 2 minutes.

steps.title: EPAY Confirms Eligibility
steps.body: We verify you're switching from an active POS and qualify under the restaurant, bar or retail criteria.

steps.title: Switch and Get Paid
steps.body: We handle the full switch with no service gap. Once you're live on EPAY, your $3,000 bonus is on its way.

yes.title: You Qualify If…
yes.body: You currently use another POS system (Toast, Clover, Square or similar) and are switching it to EPAY POS — and your business is a restaurant, bar/lounge or retail store.

no.title: You Don't Qualify If…
no.body: You're a brand-new business without an existing POS system, or your business falls outside restaurant, bar and retail.

extra.title: Volume Requirement
extra.body: Requires $50,000+ in monthly processing volume to lock in the 0% Consumer Choice rate. Under that minimum, accounts are billed at 2.6% Interchange Plus.

extra.title: How the Bonus Works
extra.body: Your $3,000 bonus is paid once your switch to EPAY is complete and live — on top of your locked-in processing rate going forward.

offers.terms: Bonus paid only to qualifying merchants switching from an existing POS system with $50,000+ in monthly volume. Restaurant, bar and retail businesses only. Terms subject to verification.
